title: In-Person Appointments Booking Deposit Credit for Long-Standing Financial Accounts
content:
**Credit schedule.** The booking deposit on an In-Person Appointments visit is reduced according to how long the patient's Patient Financial Account has been open, counted as the days from the date the account was opened to the payment date:

| Days the financial account has been open on the payment date | Taken off the booking deposit |
|---|---|
| 1826 or more | 25.00 dollars |
| 730 to 1825 | 10.00 dollars |
| fewer than 730 | nothing |

The date the account was opened is the one shown on the Patient Financial Account.

**Edges (hypothetical accounts).** An account open 1826 days on the payment date takes 25.00 dollars off; one open 1825 days takes 10.00 dollars off. An account open 730 days takes 10.00 dollars off; one open 729 days takes nothing off.
